subject: prd/contract-gate
statement: When the currency check encounters a live design that serves a superseded or retired requirement or builds on a superseded design, the gate shall fail with a **currency** defect naming that exact stale edge unless one current, valid `currency-disposition/v1` record covers that edge; a valid record may clear only its covered edge, while every uncovered edge remains blocking.
rationale: currency remains fail-closed by default, but an exact compatibility proof avoids successor churn where the consumed contract did not change
fit_criterion: fixtures prove: an uncovered stale edge fails; one valid disposition clears exactly its named edge; a second uncovered edge still fails; a retired requirement with no live replacement cannot be cleared; the check consumes the index's stale flags and dispositions rather than changing the shared flags
